queries.result: First-party discovery located the official Ondo State Ministry of Lands & Housing LandsApp portal and the official Ondo State Surveyor-General survey-plan procedure. The portal provides land and survey applications, tracking, payments, documents and public guidance, but no anonymous city-bounded parcel map, feature service or parcel API was found.

officialSources.observation: Official Ondo State Ministry of Lands & Housing LandsApp landing page. It identifies the ministry and offers land/survey services, application tracking, payments, public documents and guidance; it does not expose a public parcel layer.

Official public catalogue of paid/charged land and survey services. Visible services are application or verification workflows; restricted items require account/approval-code access. No anonymous parcel geometry or safe parcel identity response is published.

Official Ondo State Government / Office of the Surveyor General procedure. It directs applicants to the Ministry of Lands and Housing, Office of the Surveyor General and area lands offices for survey-plan processing, establishing a local custodian route but not an open parcel API.

Official federal Surveyor-General page describing nationwide cadastral/legal survey functions and a cadastral GIS responsibility. This is general national agency evidence, not city-specific Ore coverage or a public parcel service.

remainingUncertainty: The official portal may support account-gated, approval-code, formal-request or unpublished cadastral records. The bounded anonymous requests did not establish public parcel coverage, native identity, schema, CRS or safe runtime access. This is not evidence of citywide parcel absence; the WUP point was not shifted and no exact-point absence inference was made. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account or other unsafe fields were requested.
